symptoms: tests/runtime-bugs.spec.ts:276 'start room portal is walkable' === false
tests/audit.spec.ts:482 player.reset(portal.wx, portal.wy) never stands on the portal within 8 s
regression.rootCause: legacy candidate loop probed the tile CORNER (isWalkable(tile.x, tile.y, 0.5)) while makePortal placed the beacon on the CELL CENTRE, whose radius-0.5 footprint requires all four neighbouring cells; a corner cell could be selected where the player cannot stand on the beacon.
regression.scope: legacy (non-demo) portal placement only; authored route portals were already centre-based and are unchanged.

fix.summary: new findWalkableCentreInRoom(r, near?) probes and returns the SAME cell centre that makePortal presents; placePortalForTarget and both deck-exit portal placements use it. findWalkableInRoom stays the position/spawn helper (corner probe matches the entity position) and is documented as such. No change to makePortal semantics, no half-tile revert, authored portals untouched.
fix.minimalNewTests: none added. The two unmodified legacy specs are the regression gate; a new unit test would only mirror the expression, so it was deliberately skipped.
